decision.explanation: Multiple documents (d00, d01) explicitly identify Chilperic I, the King of Neustria (561–584), as the son of Clotaire I. Other documents contain contradictory or erroneous claims (e.g., Lothair I in d02, Guntram in d03) or refer to different individuals named Chilperic (Chilperic II of Burgundy in d04, Chilperic II of Neustria in d05), which are excluded based on the context of the primary historical figure described in the majority of consistent sources.
